{{Top}}
[[File:PhaseICloneLieutenant-TROSPromoYT.png|thumb|141px|A [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] clone trooper [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]]]
{{Quote|Hmm... learned something today, have you lieutenant, hmm?''"<br />"''I think we all did, General.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and clone trooper lieutenant [[Thire/Legends|Thire]]|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], '''Clone Lieutenants''' were [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] specially trained as [[Officer/Legends|officers]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], and recognized by the unique blue markings on their helmets and torso armor. They would, however, often wear [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was specifically painted to match the environment.<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref>

==Function==
[[File:Galle2.png|thumb|left|150px|Lieutenant Galle of the 327th Star Corps]]
[[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] commanded [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] comprising four [[Squad/Legends|squads]], or thirty-six troops.<ref name="Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> Numerous lieutenants participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], where they made their debut in battle, along with many of the other ranks of clones. Clone trooper lieutenants often reported to their respective [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captains]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Gear==
Clone trooper lieutenants wore distinguished blue [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]] during the first years of the Clone Wars; later they wore armor that distinguished them by division and not by rank. [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC trooper]] lieutenants sported [[ARC trooper armor/Legends|ARC trooper armor]], which optionally provided some of these units with additional weaponry, such as hidden [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]]. These ARC lieutenants also wore skirt-like [[Kama/Legends|kamas]] that dampened blasts, had [[Rangefinder/Legends|rangefinders]] attached to their helmets, and wore command shoulder pauldrons. However, the markings on the ARC lieutenants' armor remained blue.

==Rank==
They were a rank above [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and below a [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]]. The rank of lieutenant among clones was also used for the ARC trooper private units. They sported additional command, along with better training and varying weapons, including wrist-mounted flamethrowers.
